ticker_news.title: My 3 Top ETFs to Buy in February
ticker_news.description: The author recommends three ETFs for February: Vanguard Financials ETF (VFH), Vanguard Russell 2000 ETF (VTWO), and ARK Autonomous Technology & Robotics ETF (ARKQ). The rationale includes potential benefits from falling interest rates, regulatory changes, and the attractiveness of small-cap and AI-related stocks.
ticker_news.author: Matt Frankel

ticker_news.title: Should Investors Buy Tesla Stock After Q4 Earnings?
ticker_news.description: Tesla reported an 8% decrease in vehicle revenue as it offered considerable incentives to stop the bleeding.
ticker_news.author: Parkev Tatevosian, Cfa

SPY.title: Fed's Favorite Inflation Gauge Rises As Predicted, Consumer Spending Jumps At Fastest Pace In 9 Months (UPDATED)
SPY.description: The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation measure, the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, rose 2.6% in December 2024, in line with forecasts. Personal spending also jumped 0.7%, the strongest gain since March 2024, indicating the health of U.S. consumers.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
